titulo: Walking toward each other until they meet
caption:
Walking toward each other until they meet

Nobody asked whose turn it was to travel. They walked toward each other until they met.

Meeting halfway takes the same effort from both sides, and nobody has to keep count of who came last time.

For whoever meets them halfway.

Choose friction.
